short.en: Exposes GLPI as an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server so AI assistants like Claude and Microsoft Copilot can work with tickets, the knowledge base, the service catalog, projects, and users/groups conversationally.

long.en:
**MCP Server** connects GLPI to AI assistants over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), letting tools like Claude and Microsoft Copilot work with GLPI conversationally.
### Capabilities - Search, review, and update tickets in plain language — full history, follow-ups, tasks, solutions, and approvals - Query the knowledge base and complete service catalog forms in natural language - User and group management - Project tracking with cost visibility
### Access control Tool access follows GLPI's existing profiles: Standard and Central profiles get the full toolset, while Self-Service and Helpdesk profiles are limited to their own tickets and FAQ resources.
### Platform support Works on GLPI Cloud and on-premise instances alike (GLPI 11.0.0–11.9.99). Built with Twig templating, avoids direct SQL queries, and every endpoint enforces permission validation.
### Access MCP Server is distributed under an annual subscription. Request access and see current pricing at the homepage link above.
